t: You are on Argyll Street in Soho, which links Great Marlborough Street in the south to Oxford Street in the north. Little Argyll Street connects it to Regent Street on the west side. In the past the name was sometimes spelled Argyle. The street is named after John Campbell, the Second Duke of Argyll, a field marshal and politician. He served in the Nine Years' War and the War of the Spanish Succession, and later commanded British forces in Spain.
